question: Queue item 20261030-1045-expand-crawler-scraper-47c4-u03-q05: should free_tier.unit gain a neurons term for the Cloudflare Workers AI allowance, or stay with credits? Recommendation: no new term; credits stays, and docs/conventions section 6.3 names the Neuron and CORE's API token as examples of a vendor-named unit filed under credits
why: (1) docs/conventions section 6.3 defines credits as a vendor's own unit and says stated names what one credit buys when the page says it. Cloudflare defines the Neuron as its own measure of the GPU compute a request needs and prices every model in Neurons per its own raw unit; the pricing page gives no conversion of a Neuron to GPU time, so gpu-hours would invent a number. (2) Precedent: 38 records carry credits, among them recurring allowances in a vendor-named unit: data-apis/core-ac-uk (CORE's API token, named tokens by CORE, 100 a day), data-apis/geoapify (3,000 credits a day) and dev-services/pipedream (a credit is 30 seconds of compute). (3) A term for one vendor's coinage does not scale: the queued unit questions ask for terms for a class of quantity that several vendors share (records, downloads, events, seats, hosts, quota-share), which a Neuron is not; no other record's allowance is counted in Neurons. (4) Against: Cloudflare's own docs use credits for the prepaid AI Gateway balance (Unified Billing), so credits could be read as that balance; crawler-scraper/cfai free_tier.notes now says AI Gateway credits are a separate payment route and not the unit. If a rules session adds neurons, the three Workers AI records change in one run. Pages: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/ and https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/features/unified-billing/
